data.narrative:
Dandelion Energy is a Series C climate and energy company founded by James Quazi and Kathy Hannun, having raised $174.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Lanza Technologies, LNZA) in the same sector and stage, including KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $174M in total raised as a proxy base and applying a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $297M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage, same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The divergence between methods reflects heterogeneity in capital deployment and maturity profiles within early-stage climate tech.

Triangulating across both approaches produces a low estimate of $252M, a median of $648M, and a high of $1.1B. The $648M midpoint reflects equal weighting of the stage-progression and peer-median methods. Key uncertainties include the relevance of peer valuations given differing technology risk profiles, capital intensity trajectories, and path-to-commercialization timelines within the climate energy sector.
